title: Set the NU7 Mainnet activation height
body:
### Context

Once the ZIP editors publish Testnet and Mainnet activation heights, Zebra needs them wired in, the `zcash_unstable = "nu7"` gate removed, and the release prepared.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `NSM_REISSUANCE_HEIGHT` for Mainnet and Testnet (the February 2031 heights assigned in #1363) added as network constants consumed by #TBD; a unit test asserts `NSMSubsidy` is zero at `NSM_REISSUANCE_HEIGHT − 1` and non-zero at `NSM_REISSUANCE_HEIGHT` given a positive reserve.
- [ ] Testnet NU7 activation height added to `TESTNET_ACTIVATION_HEIGHTS` (`zebra-chain/src/parameters/network/testnet.rs`, referenced at line 505) and Mainnet height to the Mainnet activation table in `zebra-chain/src/parameters/network_upgrade.rs`, each with a comment citing the deployment ZIP revision.
- [ ] librustzcash `NetworkUpgrade::Nu7 => None` activation heights (`consensus.rs` lines 504, 539) updated upstream and the dependency bumped, so Zebra and upstream agree.
- [ ] `zcash_unstable = "nu7"` gating removed from all NU7 code paths (audit with `rg 'zcash_unstable = "nu7"'`); `#[cfg]`-gated tests promoted to default.
- [ ] `NetworkUpgrade::current()` and `target_spacing_for_height()` return `Nu7` / 25s at the Mainnet activation height in a unit test.
- [ ] Checkpoint list regenerated up to a height comfortably below Testnet activation; confirm no checkpoint is placed at or after activation until the upgrade is live.
- [ ] Release candidate cut with an activation-height-based end-of-support / `EOS_PANIC_AFTER` review, per the release checklist in `book/src/dev/` (locate the release process page).
- [ ] Zeeder released against this Zebra release (bumping `zebra-network`/`zebra-chain`, updating its compiled-target tests) and deployed to all production seeders **before the Testnet activation height**, so the activation observer has the NU7 target and a diverse address book in time.
- [ ] `getblockchaininfo` / `getnetworkinfo` RPC output reports NU7 with the correct branch ID and activation height (existing upgrade-info tests extended).
- [ ] Changelog fragments via `changie` for the activation heights and the removal of the unstable gate (`-k Added` / `-k Changed`).

---

### Scope

- `zebra-chain/src/parameters/network_upgrade.rs`, `zebra-chain/src/parameters/network/testnet.rs`
- Removal of `zcash_unstable = "nu7"` gates across the workspace
- Checkpoint files, release tooling, `.changes/` fragments

---
### Blockers

- Deployment ZIP revision with Testnet and Mainnet activation heights.
- #11445


### Related Issues

- Deployment draft: https://github.com/zcash/zips/pull/1363
- ZIP 200 (network upgrade mechanism), ZIP 201 (peer management across upgrades).
- Closes #9508 and #9501.
